title: Lian Li HydroShift LCD 360S White AIO Liquid Cooler

comparisons.notes: Model HSLCD36SW, White, listed in stock online.
MPN HSLCD36SW, UPC 840353046504, New, White, listed in stock.

writeup: Lian Li's HydroShift LCD 360S in white (model HSLCD36SW) is a 360mm all-in-one liquid cooler with three 120mm fans and a 2.88-inch 480x480 screen on the pump head. Woot has it new for $89.99, about half the $179.99 Central Computers charges, and only a handful were left when we checked.
amazon_match_notes: Exact match: Lian Li HydroShift LCD 360S White, MPN HSLCD36SW, UPC 840353046504.
